subject: Startups
title: Co-Founder Agreements
description: A quick, practical guide to Co-Founder Agreements.

hook.text: Handshake deals between friends turn into lawsuits between enemies. A co-founder agreement prevents the transformation.

buildup.text: The agreement covers equity splits, roles, vesting, IP ownership, decision-making, and what happens if someone leaves.

discovery.text: The vesting cliff is critical: typically a one-year cliff, then monthly vesting over four years.

twist.text: Writing the agreement forces hard conversations early. If you can't agree on paper, you'll definitely clash in practice.

climax.text: Spend $2,000 on a lawyer now or $200,000 on one later. The agreement is the cheapest insurance a startup can buy.

punchline.text: Good fences make good co-founders. Write it down.
